body:
## Summary
Fixes #5808.
**Root cause:** The wrong-flow branch only logged a warning, then still built inject events and called inject_event, so non-flow values (e.g. a bare @focus string) hit flow.client_conn and raised AttributeError.
**Fix:** Return right after that warning in inject.websocket, inject.tcp, and inject.udp.
## Changes
- mitmproxy/addons/proxyserver.py: return after each inject type check fails.
- test/mitmproxy/addons/test_proxyserver.py: inject_websocket with str so invalid input does not crash.
## Testing
- test_inject_fail: added str flow case; existing cases unchanged.
title: fix: skip inject_event when inject flow type is wrong
